name: Project Tracker
summary: A local-first tracker for a portfolio of AI-agent projects and their MVP statements. The web UI is a 1:1 clone of the aibast-agents-library project-tracker tool; the bundled ProjectTracker agent manages the same portfolio headlessly over /chat. Both speak the tool's native projectTrackerData JSON, so exports and imports round-trip with it. Self-contained and stdlib-only: the UI works offline via localStorage, and unifies with the agent's on-device store when the rapplication's local server is running.
tagline: Track AI-agent projects and their MVPs, local-first — a web UI plus a headless agent over one JSON.
